title: Proof of Human
description: A credential attesting that the subject is likely a human, with Bayesian credence level.

credence.description: Bayesian credence level (0.0-1.0) indicating confidence that the subject is human

evidence.description: Description of the evidence or reasoning behind the credence assessment

verifiedAt.description: Timestamp when the verification was performed

methodology.description: The method used to assess humanness (e.g., 'conversational-analysis', 'behavioral-patterns', 'biometric-verification')
